pages.title: Choose Your Starting Size
pages.text:
We have ready-made starting points (templates) so you do not have to build everything from scratch.

**Bronze** is the team pack open today. Silver and Gold are the growth ladder as those packs ship. You can expand later at any time.
examples: A small team with an established portfolio (about 5–20 people) -> Bronze (recommended start)
A growing company with more locations and processes -> Silver (coming soon)
A large / multi-entity organisation -> Gold (coming soon)
choices: Bronze Template: Small team with product portfolio, roughly 5–20 employees (recommended)
Silver Template: Growing company, more locations, up to ~100 employees (coming soon)
Gold Template: Large enterprise / multi-company complexity (coming soon)
